maddeler.e:
يتبادرون (form VI)
# يَتَبَادَرُونَ (yatabādarūna) /ja.ta.baː.da.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
# يُتَبَادَرُونَ (yutabādarūna) /ju.ta.baː.da.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَبَادَرَ (tabādara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
